{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with stricter parsing to ensure no QA orders are missed
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv', dtype=str)

# Check for exact string match to '999999.99'
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
qa_orders = df[qa_mask]

print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"First 5 rows of QA orders:\n{qa_orders.head()}")"}
